title: Avi.eSafety: The Leading Platform For Adverse Events & Safety Reporting
summary: Avi.eSafety is a comprehensive, web-based pharmacovigilance platform for processing and storing drug, device and vaccine adverse events and safety reporting.Avi.eSafety can be used for: • Clinical Trial Safety reporting • Drug and Device ongoing safety management and reporting • CRO Safety recording and reportingKey FeaturesAccessibleFast configuration for any applicationCloudBrowser based access on any device, in any location, at any timeSecurityAccredited and hosted in Australian based Tier 4
